name: Band-pass filter

semantics.definition: A filter response that passes a bounded band of frequencies and attenuates frequencies below and above that band.

evidence.claim: Defines and illustrates band-pass filtering as a frequency-response concept.
Provides related band-pass terminology and circuit-diagram symbols, not the target compact audio glyph.

notes: This entry does not specify bandwidth, slope, or center frequency.
The representative glyph is a concept, not vendor artwork.
